messages.text: A and I both want the trailer in the next few weeks, and neither of us is backing down. B's pad is where it lives, so she is stuck in the middle. Can you help the three of us sort this out?
I need the trailer available for my home project in the next few weeks. I need to be able to use it, not just wait until A’s finished.
I’d like the trailer not to be in the way on my pad. I did go along with keeping it here, though, so I don’t want to make it sound like I’m blaming anyone.
Yes, that fits. Underneath it, I need some freedom to plan and use the trailer for my own project, not have my plans depend on someone else’s schedule.
I want the freedom to take the trailer on my weekend trips without having to negotiate each use. I’m hoping to start within the next few weeks.

Mostly, yes. I’d like the pad clear, though I feel a bit awkward asking since I agreed to keep it there. I’d also need to check with my landlord before changing what’s kept on the pad; I haven’t asked him yet.
I’d like a predictable arrangement I can rely on, without having to renegotiate each time.
Yes, that fits. Please note I feel awkward asking, since I agreed to the arrangement and feel I owe A and C. I’d need my landlord’s approval before changing what’s kept on the pad.
Yes, that fits. Freedom to use it without having to ask or negotiate each time is the point.
Understood. Please make sure the options include a predictable way for me to use it in the next few weeks.

My concern: “share the next few weeks” doesn’t guarantee enough time for my project. We need to agree actual dates and a usable block for me, not just assume a split works. No need for the whole period, but I can’t wait until A is done.
I’d prefer it not come back to my pad between uses, if there’s a workable alternative. I do feel awkward saying that, and I’d need to ask my landlord before changing the arrangement.
A concern: fixed blocks could limit spontaneous trips, though I’m willing to plan dates. I don’t want to commit to off-pad storage or any cost until we know the details.
